full_source_clock: Original uniform8-kHz reference, unchanged f64 filter, fixed100-ms edges, no fitted gain/delay/clock
scope: Same complete encoded streams on the same deterministic clock, oldfloor versus fixedcentered lookup. This isolates quantizer bin selection; it is not optimized new encoder/player output or release proof.
decision: Reject unconditional centered-LUT-only replacement on frozen floor-optimized payloads:all8 non-silent sources regress in both models. Midpoint silence confirms the negative-zero bin-discontinuity mechanism and removes the approximately1996-Hz line, but matched encoder re-optimization and actual execution are required before considering midpoint+centered lookup. No new disk or release is accepted.
